source.title: Call for Applicants - WCAT Members (October 2020)
source.content:
The **WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT)** is seeking new members! Applications are open to everyone, and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.
 
**The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:**
* Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
* Handling change requests to competitions.
* Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2020.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf). Please note that the expected workload is around **1 to 1.5 hours per day**.  
 <!-- break -->
**The main qualities of members we are seeking include:**
* A sense of detail.
* Commitment and solution-oriented to help Delegates in all the requests they can have.
* Proactiveness in daily communication with the rest of the Team and the Delegates.
* Good familiarity with the [WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf).
* Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.
* High level of proficiency in English.
 
**Other qualities which are good to have:**
* Having experience with competition organization and with group work. 
* Speaking more than one language.
* Coding Experience.
 
**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
* A brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Goals as a member and why you are seeking to join.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **November 8th 2020 23:59 UTC** to Wilson Alvis ([walvis@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:walvis@worldcubeassociation.org)). 

Thank you and take care!

translation.title: WCA 比赛公示组成员招募（2020 年 10 月）
translation.content:
**WCA 比赛公示组（WCAT）**正在招募新成员！申请面向所有人开放，欢迎目前未在 WCA 任职的社区成员申请。

**WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：**

* 准确审核并公布提交的比赛申请。
* 处理比赛信息的修改申请。
* 与团队其他成员讨论并参与投票。

WCAT 的正式权利和职责见 [WCA 决议 10.2020.2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2020.2%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf)。请注意，预计每天需要投入约 **1 至 1.5 小时**。

<!-- break -->

**我们希望成员主要具备以下条件：**

* 注重细节。
* 认真负责，愿意寻找办法，协助代表处理各类请求。
* 主动与团队其他成员及代表保持日常沟通。
* 熟悉《[WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Requirements.pdf)》。
* 对 WCA 规则和政策有足够了解。
* 熟练使用英语。

**以下能力也会有所帮助：**

* 有组织比赛及团队协作经验。
* 会使用不止一种语言。
* 有编程经验。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
* 加入后的目标，以及申请加入的原因。

申请期为即日起至 **2020 年 11 月 8 日 23:59 UTC**。请将材料发送给 Wilson Alvis（[walvis@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:walvis@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

谢谢大家，祝平安！
